ContentElementId.title: Content element id
ContentElementId.description: Element identifier. Any non-empty string, except the reserved literal `__page_context_root__`, an id that reads as an integer (`0`, `12`, `-3`; `012` and `1.5` do not), or an id carrying a line terminator (U+000A, U+000D, U+2028, U+2029); those are rejected with `400`. The id is stored verbatim, so an author-supplied id such as `hero` names that element instance and is as valid as a generated hex id.
